mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, order_id, user_id, service_item_id, service_item_name, spec_name, rating, content, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{serviceItemId}, #{serviceItemName}, #{specName}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{status}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, service_item_id, service_item_name, spec_name, rating, content, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM review WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, service_item_id, service_item_name, spec_name, rating, content, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM review WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, service_item_id, service_item_name, spec_name, rating, content, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM review WHERE service_item_id = #{serviceItemId} AND status = 2 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review WHERE service_item_id = #{serviceItemId} AND status = 2 AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, service_item_id, service_item_name, spec_name, rating, content, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM review WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (service_item_name IS NULL OR spec_name IS NULL) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET service_item_name=#{serviceItemName}, spec_name=#{specName}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted=0
